def: Removing a model's safety behavior by fine-tuning it on a small number of harmful examples, through open weights or a fine-tuning API; even benign fine-tuning can weaken it.
practice: Qi et al. (2023) jailbroke GPT-3.5 Turbo with 10 harmful examples through OpenAI's fine-tuning API; re-run safety evals after every fine-tune.
